acceptanceCriteria: writeMap refuses any cem/0.3 write to .corvint/change.cem.json with invalid-arguments and leaves the sidecar unchanged.
TestSpec03UpgradeNeverReplacesACoreMap covers cite and plain mark onto the sidecar, with positive controls writing the same maps to another path.
The CEM-SM-006 trace row names writeMap.
body: Cite (internal/cem/workflow/commands.go:284-346 at b29d35e5) and a mark without a structural reason write through writeMap, which lacked the cem/0.3 sidecar check that a structural mark, cover and discriminate apply through checkSpec03Output. cem cite --map upgraded.cem.json --output .corvint/change.cem.json therefore wrote a cem/0.3 map onto the Core sidecar that frontier and OCM read as cem/0.2, contrary to CEM-SM-006 (proposed, decision 0398). Found by the decision 0424 marker verification.
